roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and maintaining rigorous infection prevention standards, ensuring the highest quality of care for our residents.

In this full-time position, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing educational programs for staff, as well as overseeing all aspects of infection control within the facility. Your expertise will directly contribute to staff competency, patient safety, and regulatory compliance. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42.

If you are a proactive RN with a passion for education and infection control, and are ready to make a significant impact in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Proven experience in staff development and education.
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control.
Strong understanding of healthcare regulations and compliance.
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a recently acquired facility, bringing your expertise to a growing and evolving environment. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in shaping our market presence and driving admissions.As Marketing Director, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies, fostering strong community relationships, and ensuring a positive public image. We are looking for a highly presentable and proactive individual with a 'hustler' mentality, ready to take initiative and achieve results. This role requires flexibility, including the ability to work occasional weekends to meet business needs. We offer competitive compensation for the right candidate who can make a significant impact.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably in a skilled nursing or healthcare setting
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute effective marketing strategies
Professional and presentable demeanor with excellent communication skills
A proactive, results-driven approach and strong interpersonal abilities
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as required
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is competitive and based on experience for the right candidate.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers the flexibility of PRN work while providing essential therapy services to patients.

As an SLP, you will play a vital role in assessing, diagnosing, and treating individuals with communication and swallowing disorders. This position offers a competitive hourly rate and a significant sign-on or relocation bonus, reflecting the urgency and value of this role. Join a team committed to patient recovery and well-being.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49 per hour, with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.
